facts.fact: The NSA says the 2023 PHC counted all persons present on census night 24 September 2023; enumeration ran 25 September to 6 October 2023 with mop-up to 30 October 2023 (population 3,022,401).
The NSA released the 2023 PHC Main Report on 30 October 2024, which it says contains final results; preliminary results had been launched in March 2024.
